plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Theatre, Fine Arts, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/fine-arts-theater-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Theatre Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Students choose between Performance and Production tracks: the grid presents the track courses as pairs separated by a blank row (THTR 200/THTR 205, THTR 240/THTR 235, THTR 230/THTR 232) — modeled as track-choice slots; take the course for the chosen track. Grid rows shown only as a footnote number with units (4, 6) do not name a specific course in the published schedule and are not defined on this page — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number preserved in choice_note; see advisor. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
